name: io.github.pranavsaji/exorcist-98
title: Exorcist 98
description: Antivirus for AI coding agents: scan repos and MCP configs for prompt injection and poisoned tools.

environmentVariables.name: EXORCIST_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Extra folders the tools may read besides the start folder, separated like PATH. Client MCP roots are also used.

environmentVariables.name: EXORCIST_MCP_NO_QUOTES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to never return quoted file text, even when a tool call asks for it.
